assessment: Using the Drosophila tracheal system as a model for apical membrane expansion of tubes, the authors convincingly demonstrate that ectodomain shedding of the Zona Pellucida (ZP) domain protein Piopio by the Matriptase homolog Notopleural releases its linkage with the ZP protein Dumpy and thus ensures proper apical membrane function and tube expansion. Given the high degree of conservation of these proteins in other species, the results presented are important for future analysis and will have further implications on tubular development and homoestasis in other systems, including human.
